title: Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments
title_zh: 裁判官遵循参考信息：验证工具调用参数中的推导差距

paragraphs.en: 裁判官遵循参考信息：验证工具调用参数时的推导差距 Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate and writes a reference for the judge. Across three benchmarks, DeRef improves overall argument AUROC for all judges tested. On the controlled test, it raises AUROC from chance or below to between 98.40 and 99.59.
paragraphs.zh: 裁判官遵循参考信息：验证工具调用参数时的推导差距。工具调用裁判官会评估 LLM 智能体提出的参数值。 我们发现，当输入中不存在对应值的参考信息时，即没有说明该值应为何何的文本，它们接受正确值的情况会更少。 这种情况发生在该值是函数模式中用户未提及的默认值、需要推断得出，或其所来源的文本被从裁判官输入中截断时。 我们将这种接受率的下降称为“推导差距”。 在我们评估的全部七位裁判官中，这一现象普遍存在，包括 System One 模型 CLM 和 Jev。 这种差距并非仅仅是截断造成的影响：在没有截断的基准测试中，正确的默认值反而表现出最大的差距。 一项受控的源信息重定位测试表明，裁判官会遵循输入中的参考信息：它们会更倾向于一个可见的错误值，而非一个来源被隐藏的正确值。 我们引入了 DeRef（派生参考）：一个独立的模型会读取完整的历史记录，但不会看到候选值，并为裁判官生成参考信息。 在三个基准测试中，DeRef 提升了所有受测裁判官的整体参数 AUROC。 在受控测试中，它将 AUROC 从随机水平或更低提升至 98.40 到 99.59 之间。
